message.content:
The user wants a 7-day learning roadmap for building a full-stack web app with React (frontend) and Go (backend). They also want it bilingual: key terms in both English and 中文. I need to list daily content and exercises. I'll structure it as a table with Day, Topic (English/中文), Content, and Exercises. I'll make it comprehensive but concise, focusing on core concepts and hands-on practice. Day 1: React basics, setup, components, JSX. Day 2: Go basics, setup, syntax, concurrency basics. Day 3: Connect React frontend to Go backend via REST API. Day 4: Database integration (SQL), backend CRUD. Day 5: Authentication, JWT, security basics. Day 6: Deployment, Docker, CI/CD basics. Day 7: Project polish, testing, performance optimization. I'll include key terms in both languages, like "Component/组件", "Goroutine/协程", etc. I'll keep the exercises practical and actionable. # 🚀 7-Day Full-Stack Learning Roadmap: React + Go ## React 前端 + Go 后端 | React Frontend + Go Backend | Day | Topic (EN/中文) | Core Content | Hands-On Exercises | |-----|----------------|--------------|---------------------| | **Day 1** | **React Basics
React 基础** | • JSX syntax / JSX 语法
• Components & Props / 组件与属性
• State & Lifecycle / 状态与生命周期
• Event Handling / 事件处理 | Build a simple counter app with increment/decrement buttons.
构建一个带增减按钮的简单计数器应用。 | | **Day 2** | **Go Basics
Go 基础** | • Variables & Data Types / 变量与数据类型
• Functions & Methods / 函数与方法
• Structs & Interfaces / 结构体与接口
• Goroutines & Channels / 协程与通道
• HTTP Server setup / HTTP 服务器搭建 | Create a basic Go HTTP server that responds with "Hello, World!" on `/hello`.
创建一个 Go HTTP 服务器，在 `/hello` 路径返回 "Hello, World!"。 | | **Day 3** | **REST API Integration
REST API 集成** | • React `fetch` / `axios` for API calls
• Go `net/http` or `gin` framework for routing
• JSON encoding/decoding / JSON 编解码
• CORS handling / 跨域资源共享处理 | Connect React frontend to Go backend: fetch a list of items from Go API and display them.
连接 React 前端到 Go 后端：从 Go API 获取列表并展示。 | | **Day 4** | **Database Integration
数据库集成** | • SQL basics (PostgreSQL/MySQL)
• Go database driver (`database/sql`)
• CRUD operations / 增删改查操作
• Environment variables / 环境变量 | Implement a "Todo" backend: CRUD endpoints for tasks, stored in a database.
实现 "待办事项" 后端：任务的增删改查接口，数据存入数据库。 | | **Day 5** | **Authentication & Security
认证与安全** | • JWT (JSON Web Token) basics
• Password hashing (bcrypt)
• Middleware for protected routes / 受保护路由的中间件
• Frontend auth state management / 前端认证状态管理 | Add user registration and login to the app: issue JWT on success, protect routes.
为应用添加用户注册和登录：成功后发放 JWT，保护路由。 | | **Day 6**
